description: Hosted apps with a dev and a main branch, shipped as container images: routine updates on dev, only security fixes on main.

packageRules.description: main only gets security fixes: vulnerabilityAlerts forces them through this rule, as pull requests
Node in .nvmrc and in the Dockerfile base images moves as one update. Schedule and automerge follow the update type (patch, minor, major) as in the shared preset.

Packages pinned in `apk add` (found by the dockerfile manager) are looked up in Alpine latest-stable, the release node:…-alpine and alpine:3 follow; the index carries build dates for the cooldown. One branch for all update types: when a new Alpine release becomes latest-stable, the pins and the image digests that move to it land together.
New digests of the node and alpine images (same tag, e.g. a new Alpine release) join the alpine branch, and a waiting node minor or major pull request does not hold them back.

dev: every non-major update in one branch on Monday mornings that merges itself after CI, so routine updates deploy dev once a week. Majors, TypeScript, security fixes and lock file maintenance stay separate; ramen-workflows keeps its own immediate slot.
